formatDecision.actualDidacticDecision: Existing wide friendly comic layout retained; three actual uncropped scales seen. New aspect ratio or style overhaul not required.

actualSubjectReview: Environmental, social and governance criteria are distinct from intended impact and actual evidence. The explicit statement rejects automatic ethical quality from a high ESG score and causal proof from an impact claim. The decorative chart has no measured data values.
actualActorPerspectiveAndReadabilityRevi: The foreground cards are outward analytical panels, while the actor has only abstract note lines. Three large headings and icons remain clear at360; small question lists are optional. The arrows structure analysis rather than guarantee impact.

curriculumSourceReading.actualWholeUnitsRead: Printed/PDF48and49 Q4 introduction and Q4.1–Q4.3 whole units actually read; themes selected by decree, not all universally compulsory. No full multi-jurisdiction mapping coverage or authored-scope projection review claimed.

altTextCandidateFromActualMotif: Drei große Felder unterscheiden ESG-Kriterien, beabsichtigte Wirkung und Nachweise. Eine Person fragt nach Messung, Grenzen und möglichen anderen Ursachen beobachteter Veränderungen.
